question.text: Under FEMA, investments in units of AIFs are considered:

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the FEMA Non-debt Instruments Rules 2019, investment in units of AIFs (and REITs/InvITs) is treated as a non-debt instrument. The Trap: AIF units are NOT debt instruments. There is no separate 'hybrid' category here. Cross-Exam Context: Same for Cat I/II (XIX-A). Distributor's Pro-Tip: Align NRI investor reporting with NDI Rules — foreign investors in AIFs follow the non-debt framework.
